name: [CUSTOMIZATION] Live of Life [DoD, but good?]
desc:
Ever played Die of Death? Well then you have probably heard of the joke Live of Life. Why be a joke when it could be real? 

Dont take this game seriously! If DoD is a joke game, then this is an even bigger joke. Even though the title says 'but good?' the game is supposed to be worse than Die Of Death.
Huge thanks to the DoD dev team for making such an inspiring game.

Thumbnail credits: Froggy, Paiiscary, meet_mark, epikgogy, galatcs

NOTE: This is not a 1:1 recreation of DoD. This game has been made from the ground up. Not a single asset is taken from Die Of Death. It does not aim to be an exact replicate of DoD, just heavily inspired by it! Specifically the late april state.
Important notice: Bildirmin is not a misspell, its a very important character.

scripts.script:
-- u can use it to your script <3
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer


local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Parent = screenGui
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 50)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.4, 0)
toggleButton.Text = "Infinite Stamina: OFF"
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleButton.TextSize = 18
toggleButton.Active = true
toggleButton.Draggable = true


local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Parent = toggleButton
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)


local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.Parent = toggleButton
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-----------------------------------------------------
-- toggle code 
-----------------------------------------------------

local infiniteEnabled = false
local staminaConnections = {}

local function enableInfiniteStamina(plr)
    local character = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local SprintStuff = character:WaitForChild("SprintStuff")
    local Stamina = SprintStuff:WaitForChild("Stamina")
    local MaxStamina = SprintStuff:WaitForChild("MaxStamina")
    
    local infiniteValue = MaxStamina.Value

    
    if staminaConnections[plr] then
        staminaConnections[plr]:Disconnect()
    end

    
    staminaConnections[plr] = Stamina.Changed:Connect(function()
        if infiniteEnabled then
            Stamina.Value = infiniteValue
        end
    end)

    Stamina.Value = infiniteValue
end

local function disableInfiniteStamina(plr)
    if staminaConnections[plr] then
        staminaConnections[plr]:Disconnect()
        staminaConnections[plr] = nil
    end
end

-----------------------------------------------------
-- betten 
-----------------------------------------------------

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    infiniteEnabled = not infiniteEnabled

    if infiniteEnabled then
        toggleButton.Text = "Infinite Stamina: ON"
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 60)

        
        enableInfiniteStamina(player)

    else
        toggleButton.Text = "Infinite Stamina: OFF"
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)

        
        disableInfiniteStamina(player)
    end
end)

getgenv().UseWalk = getgenv().UseWalk or false

getgenv().OriginalRunSpeed = getgenv().OriginalRunSpeed or nil

local ESPObjects = {}

local function CreateESP(character, color, name)
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    ESPObjects[character] = {
        Highlight = highlight,
        Billboard = billboard,
        TextLabel = textLabel,

    }
    
    local connection

            textLabel.Text = string.format("%s\n[%.0f studs]", name, distance)

            ESPObjects[character].Billboard:Destroy()
        end
        ESPObjects[character] = nil
